fixes: BM25 intersects exact numeric postings before selecting candidates, preventing evidence with conflicting factual numbers from being returned solely through shared nouns.
CharNgram preserves exact per-generation numeric BitSets and requires each explicit numeric token for candidate eligibility, preserving R7 atomic snapshot and R10 negation membership.
Temporal phrase 'vor N Tagen' is excluded from required factual numbers; all other factual numerals remain exact.
caveats: Stricter numeric filtering may reduce recall if docs express numbers in words or other formats; do not promote before official holdout.
Numbers elsewhere in a document may match without proving the requested fact; this is a retrieval gate, not semantic entailment.
The test mirror uses only host stub for EventEmittingRetriever and JUnit, never the actual Android integration.
